title: Venue logos – horizontal
slide_intent: Teach designers to change the lockup when a long, narrow surface would make a stacked name too small to read.
strategic_value: The same venue names and line devices can extend into signage formats with different proportions.
demonstration: Six single-line venue names are stacked vertically for comparison. Each retains its own underline or frame.
practical_value: Select the horizontal master when the available strip favors a single line, including long horizontal or vertical signage.

content_islands.name: Format guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the title and left column beside the examples. Explain the role of horizontal masters in extreme spaces.

content_islands.name: Horizontal masters
content_islands.spec: Present all six names as separate lockups in one vertical column. Preserve each venue’s complete line device and leave space between examples.
